H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H623: Asaph, the name of three Israelites, and of the family of the first
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H5159: properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion
H2930: to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense (contaminated)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H1964: a large public building, such as a palace or temple
H6944: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
H3389: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H5038: a flabby thing, i.e. a carcase or carrion (human or bestial, often collectively); figuratively, an idol
H3978: an eatable (includ. provender, flesh and fruit)
H5775: a bird (as covered with feathers, or rather as covering with wings), often collectively
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H1320: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of aman
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H8210: to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out
H1818: blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood)
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H5439: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H7934: a resident; by extension, a fellow-citizen
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H599: to breathe hard, i.e. be enraged
H5331: properly, a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards; hence (figuratively), splendor, or (subjectively) truthfulness, or (objectively) confidence; but usually (adverbially), continually (i.e. to the most distant point of view)
H1197: to kindle, i.e. consume (by fire or by eating); to be(-come) brutish
H3644: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately as, thus, so
H2534: heat; figuratively, anger, poison (from its fever)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H4467: dominion, i.e. (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm)
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H5116: (adjectively) at home; hence (by implication of satisfaction) lovely; also (noun) a home, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (den)
H8074: to stun (or intransitively, grow numb), i.e. devastate or (figuratively) stupefy (both usually in a passive sense)
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H2142: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention; to be male
H7223: first, in place, time or rank (as adjective or noun)
H6923: to project (one self), i.e. precede; hence, to anticipate, hasten, meet (usually for help)
H7356: compassion (in the plural); by extension, the womb (as cherishing the fetus); by implication, a maiden
H1809: to slacken or be feeble; figuratively, to be oppressed
H3966: properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated)
H5826: to surround, i.e. protect or aid
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H5337: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense
H3722: to cover (specifically with bitumen); figuratively, to expiate or condone, to placate or cancel
H2403: an offence (sometimes habitual sinfulness), and its penalty, occasion, sacrifice, or expiation; also (concretely) an offender
H4616: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H5360: avengement, whether the act of the passion
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H2220: the arm (as stretched out), or (of animals) the foreleg; figuratively, force
H3498: to jut over or exceed; by implication, to excel; (intransitively) to remain or be left; causatively, to leave, cause to abound, preserve
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H2778: to pull off, i.e. (by implication) to expose (as by stripping); specifically, to betroth (as if a surrender); figuratively, to carp at, i.e. defame; to spend the winter
H136: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H6629: a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)
H3034: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H1755: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling
H5608: properly, to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe, and also to enumerate; intensively, to recount, i.e. celebrate
